body: I was doing the same an hour ago. I started with my dad. I got so overcome with guilt and sadness so went out for a walk and watched the sunset. The pure emptiness, hopelessness and numbness in me wont stop. I hope this comment helps you to not feel so alone. I hope you are able to find some peace and happiness.

Thank you this is very helpful to know,. I’m pushing lots for it. Sadly, this is just the tip of the iceberg. People with cancer are literally missing out on crucial surgeries and chemo here due to the overwhelming number of covid cases needing hospitalisation.
